defs.d: A portal of entry into a building, room, or vehicle, consisting of a rigid plane movable on a hinge. Doors are frequently made of wood or metal. May have a handle to help open and close, a latch to hold the door closed and a lock that ensures the door cannot be opened without the key.
defs.ex: I knocked on the vice president's door

defs.d: Any flap, etc. that opens like a door.
defs.ex: the 24 doors in an Advent calendar

defs.d: To cause a collision by opening the door of a vehicle in front of an oncoming cyclist or pedestrian.
The spectral composition of visible light
defs.ex: Humans and birds can perceive color.

defs.d: A subset thereof:
To give something color.
defs.ex: We could color the walls red.

defs.d: To apply colors to the areas within the boundaries of a line drawing using colored markers or crayons.
defs.ex: My kindergartener loves to color.

defs.d: Conveying color, as opposed to shades of gray.
defs.ex: Color television and movies were considered a great improvement over black and white.

defs.d: The present time.
defs.ex: Now is the right time.

defs.d: (often with "the") The state of not paying attention to the future or the past.
defs.ex: She is living in the now.

defs.d: Present; current.
Fashionable; popular; up to date; current.
defs.ex: I think this band's sound is very now.

defs.d: At the present time.
defs.ex: Now I am six.

defs.d: (sentence) Used to introduce a point, a qualification of what has previously been said, a remonstration or a rebuke.
defs.ex: Now stop that, Jimmy!

defs.d: The act of arranging.
The manner of being arranged.
A roughly hemispherical container used to hold, mix or present food, such as salad, fruit or soup, or other items.
As much as is held by a bowl.
defs.ex: You can’t have any more soup – you’ve had three bowls already.

defs.d: Belonging to; possessed; proper to. Often marks a possessive determiner as reflexive, referring back to the subject of the clause or sentence.
Not shared
defs.ex: When we move into the new house, the kids will each have their own bedroom.

defs.d: (modal, auxiliary verb, defective) Used before a verb to indicate the simple future tense in the first person singular or plural.
defs.ex: I hope that we shall win the game.

defs.d: Used similarly to indicate determination or obligation in the second and third persons singular or plural.
defs.ex: (determination): You shall go to the ball!

defs.d: To direct the attention of.
To submit to (another person or group) for consideration; to send or direct elsewhere.
To draw air into (inhale), and expel air from (exhale), the lungs in order to extract oxygen and excrete waste gases.
To take in needed gases and expel waste gases in a similar way.
defs.ex: Fish have gills so they can breathe underwater.

defs.d: The act of respiration; a single instance of this.
A diacritical mark indicating aspiration or lack thereof.
Vagina
To alienate; to estrange.
To be estranged or alienated.
Not normal; odd, unusual, surprising, out of the ordinary.
defs.ex: He thought it strange that his girlfriend wore shorts in the winter.

defs.d: Unfamiliar, not yet part of one's experience.
defs.ex: I moved to a strange town when I was ten.

defs.d: To take part in a race (in the sense of a contest).
defs.ex: The drivers were racing around the track.

defs.d: To compete against in such a race.
defs.ex: I raced him to the car, but he was there first, so he got to ride shotgun.

defs.d: To assign a race to; to perceive as having a (usually specified) race.
The sport of competing in races.
(plural staffs or staves) A long, straight, thick wooden rod or stick, especially one used to assist in walking.
(plural staves) A series of horizontal lines on which musical notes are written; a stave.
To supply (a business, volunteer organization, etc.) with employees or staff members.
Of a person, to continue to live; to remain alive.
Of an object or concept, to continue to exist.
In a fundamental, essential or basic manner
defs.ex: They've added some fancy features, but it's basically still a car.

defs.d: Mostly; generally; for the most part
In a significant manner or to a significant extent.
